newsitem.title: USA: Ethan Allen sees jump in first-quarter earnings.
newsitem.headline: Ethan Allen sees jump in first-quarter earnings.

text.p: Ethan Allen Interiors Inc. said Thursday it expects earnings for its first fiscal quarter to be significantly greater than the previous first quarter and higher than analysts' expectations.
The Danbury, Conn.-based manufacturer and retailer of home furnishings said it sees net income of $7.5 million to $8.0 million, or 52 cents to 55 cents a share, for its first quarter ending Sept. 30.
Last year, Ethan Allen earned $4.5 million, or 31 cents a share, in the first quarter.
"We are encouraged by the continued improvement in sales and manufacturing efficiencies," said M. Farooq Kathwari, chief executive officer.
"We believe this progress is a result of stronger performance of the dealer-owned and company-owned stores, increased international business volume and higher manufacuturing margins," he said.
A company spokesman said industry analysts' estimates for Ethan Allen's first-quarter earnings range from 40 cents to 45 cents.
Trading in Ethan Allen stock was delayed on the New York Stock Exchange, due to an imbalance. It closed Wednesday at $27.50.
